summary: Backend and frontend tested. New suite tests/test_rating_tags_pickup_first_pharmacy_summary.py: 10/10 pass. Regression with -n 0 on 8 related suites plus the new one: 114/114 pass (pickup check-in, photo shred/missed pickup, rx handoff/batch alerts, pickup-run geofence, low-rating badges, scorecard labels, pharmacy tiers, order privacy). (1) Rating tags: tags are uppercased, trimmed and deduped; unknown tags are dropped; at most 6 are kept; no tags gives []; re-rating returns 400; a pending order returns 400; no token returns 401; a non-list tags value returns 422. UI flow passed: a real CSV import for a pharmacy evening run, delivery with an uploaded photo and a signature, /customer/{code}, unlock with the last 4 digits, 5 stars plus 3 chips, then rating-thanks. The DB stored rating_tags ['ON TIME','HANDLED WITH CARE','DISCREET']. (2) Pickup-first: the route detail pickups and stops[].pickup_run include pickup_lat/pickup_lng equal to the mer-2 pickup. In the UI, pickup-first-banner shows 'PICKUP FIRST · EVENING BATCH · 5:00 PM – 5:30 PM | BAY BOOKS | 385 Fairway Rd S, Kitchener' and a red 'P' marker is on the map. Both pickup-navigate-button and the hero NAVIGATE open google.com/maps/dir to 43.4201383,-80.4404996. After the UI check-in, the banner and the P marker are gone and NAVIGATE goes to the next stop's coordinates. (3) Pharmacy summary: the numbers match seeded data: drops, delivered, failed, pickups, checked-in, on-time %, batch drops, savings = n×2.74, avg rating, ratings count and top tags. Other merchants and other weeks are excluded. A mid-week date snaps to Monday. A bad week returns 400. Non-pharmacy mer-1 returns 400 (both as bakery and as admin). Cross-merchant access returns 403 and no auth returns 401. The email endpoint returns 200 with sent_to ['delivered@resend.dev'] and the email provider returned 202. The Monday scheduler was checked live: after unsetting pharmacy_summary_week, it re-claimed 2026-W44 and sent the email within 60s. (4) Merchant portal card: values are correct for this week (2 drops, 100%, $0.00, 5★, tags). Prev week shows zeros and the email button is disabled. Next week returns to the current week. The email toast reads 'SUMMARY EMAILED TO DELIVERED@RESEND.DEV'. The mer-1 portal has no card and no error.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {sent_to:[...]} even when the week has 0 drops: email_pharmacy_summary returns early and nothing is sent. The response should say nothing was sent, e.g. {sent:false} or a 400 'No drops this week'.

pickups_checked_in and on_time_pct count db.pickups docs per route. A manifest split across 2 routes counts as 2 check-ins against 1 'pickup', so pickups_checked_in can exceed pickups. Also, only stops with a run manifest are counted; pharmacy orders uploaded without ?run= are excluded from 'drops'. Confirm this is intended.
RatingIn.tags has no max_length, so huge arrays are accepted and then truncated. Add Field(max_length=20) or similar.
The week is claimed before sending and the spawned email is never retried on failure, unlike the weekly report, which retries up to 3 times.

ui_bugs.issue: The button uses disabled={!week}. After prev then next, week is the current Monday (not null), so summary-next-week becomes enabled and the user can page into future empty weeks. Reset week to null when the shifted week reaches the current week_start, or compare against today. Reference: src/components/PharmacySummaryCard.tsx:58

Sends comment = tags.join(', '), so rating_comment duplicates rating_tags. Admin low-rating views will show the tags as the patient's comment. Send comment null unless real free text is entered. Reference: src/components/RatingPrompt.tsx submit()

issues: Tag chips are 36px tall, below the 44px touch target
Chips sit in a horizontal scroll, so 'HANDLED WITH CARE' etc. get cut off at the edge at 390px. Consider flexWrap so every option is visible.
While a pickup is pending, the red NEXT STOP card still shows stop #1, but its NAVIGATE button goes to the pharmacy. Relabel it (e.g. 'NAVIGATE TO PICKUP') or dim it to avoid confusion.
On iOS, navigate() uses Apple Maps (maps:), while the spec says Google Maps (web and Android use Google).
The week label '26 MON – 1 SUN' has no month names, which is ambiguous across a month boundary (Oct 26 – Nov 1). Add the month.
